review_description: Rhys and his team were great. Communication was impressive and we felt like more than just a  customer.

Hobbs have been given competitive pricing and installed a quality system. They installed a 8kwh worth of panels and a 10kwh battery. They have been consultative and collaborative in picking the right system for me.Would recommend them for any of your electrical needs.

Hobbs were great, they communicated well, were very punctual. Customer service was excellent, quoting in person was appreciated and they organised the entire project from quoting, through installation and the grid connection, including Level 2 ASP (NSW).Hobbs also provided an upgrade of the meter and rewiring of the 3-phase meter and switchboard, including grid backup for blackout protection.No issues at all, I would recommend them. Also generalist electricians, which is handy and have used them before.

The whole process with Hobbs Electrical was easy from start to finish. The sales team was happy to provide different options and answer questions and the installation crew were on time, fast and cleaned up every skerrick before leaving site. Highly recommended.
The whole job from start to finish went very smoothly and efficiently

We had a 10kW solar panel system installed and the experience with Rhys and the Hobbs team were great.After the initial consultation we also had another one to address some changes and concerns. All our requests were accommadated and the planning discussion was professional and informative. The installation took just a day. They arrived on time and finished with a small demonstration and practical elements in late afternoon. Our installation (Enphase system) came with new switchboard, a smart meter and a mobile app to monitor the system and production in real time.So far, it's been 10 months since the install and we have seen great results and savings. Going solar was a great investment and it was good to choose a local, reputable installer like Hobbs.

The sales and quoting process with Hobbs Electrical was excellent. I received a very detailed and transparent quote that was tailored to my specific needs and goals. Rhys took the time to understand exactly what I wanted to achieve, including electrifying my home, removing gas, and installing a system that could generate revenue by exporting excess solar to the grid. He designed a system that met my day-to-day needs, gave me flexibility for the future, and included a heat pump hot water system so I could uninstall my gas water heater.The installation process was smooth and well organised. The installers were punctual, reliable, polite, and courteous throughout. They worked efficiently, kept the site tidy, and cleaned up thoroughly after the job was completed. Everything ran to schedule, and I was impressed by the level of professionalism shown across the team.The customer service has been outstanding both before and after the installation. I was fully briefed on the battery, inverter, and basic operating procedures, and they explained how any system faults would trigger an automatic alert to both their phones and mine. That gave me real peace of mind. They also handled the grid connection and paperwork for Commonwealth and NSW rebates, which made the process seamless and stress-free. Post-installation, I was reassured that if I ever have any questions or issues, I can call them directly. Hobbs are a well-known, reputable local company in the Blue Mountains, and I have confidence they will be there to support me well into the future. This post-installation support was one of the biggest determining factors for me, and it made the decision much easier.

Was a real pleasure dealing with the Hobbs Electrical team from start to finish. They went the extra mile to make the experience of selecting the right battery, upgrading my existing solar panels whilst providing a hassle free installation at my convenience. Their experience and detail in regards to the quality of the installation and follow up after the completion of works to explain the system and its operation was excellent. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking at a battery and/or solar installation.

Hobbs electrical installed our solar panels and batteries, and the whole experience was fantastic. From the first email requesting quotes, Rhys kept in touch and arranged for Tom and his team to consult with us and complete the installation. They were efficient, professional, and courteous throughout. On the installation day, the team introduced themselves, worked smoothly, and left everything spotless. Tom even helped us set up the app, and we’re absolutely loving our new energy system. Thanks to Hobbs Electrical for such excellent service — highly recommended!

Everything from the beginning to the completion of installation was smooth, efficient, friendly and respectful.Hobbs Electrical take great pride in their work and leave behind an immaculate work site. This company also uses the best quality products.

Great experience, first with panels, battery and 3-phase board install, then followed up with battery expansion and EV charger. Quote was provided after in persion visit, options discussed and agreed. Installation was on time as quoted, work area left clean and tidy, installers were knowledgeable about the system, the tech and app(s), demonstrating use. Arranged all the paper work for 3-phase change/increased capacity. No hassles :)

Our experience with Hobbs Electrical was excellent from start to finish. They weren't the cheapest quote, but they weren't that much more expensive, but the small price difference was worth the professionalism. Rhys, who helped with the quote, actually came out to see the site, rather than doing everything online, and was incredibly helpful when I called back with a bucket load of questions about switching energy providers once the battery was installed, and helped explain the differences between the options provided, including helping me choose between battery type and size.Installation happened when they promised, and the team that did it were friendly, respectful and answered any questions I had. And when something wasn't quite right, they were back the next day to sort it straight away.The panels were all installed, and they use a nice black rail to blend in with the panels, so everything looks neat and tidy, and classy compared to our old system.All round this was a positive experience, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend if you are looking for a solar system.

We had an existing old system that needed an upgrade, we got great advice and a great quote, installation was quick and efficient and the tradies were highly competent and polite. Hobbs made every stage of the process easy and it was a pleasure dealing with them.
I got the right advice regarding installation. Customer service was good.
Customer service was without fault. Every step in the process was efficient and expertly done including leaving an impeccably clean site at the end

The sales and quoting process was prompt, efficient and accomodating to my particular requests, even when changes were desired.The  installation happened much quicker than I had anticipated, for which I was most pleased. The work was completed in a most efficient way.  They arrived on time, were very pleasant and cooperative and worked efficiently as a team till the work was completed. Everything was tidied up and the site left as they found it.I was given good instruction as to how the system worked and any questions answered. The technical matters were all attended to and the app to keep an eye on the system was sent to my phone to download. The grid connection and all matters pertaining were organised leaving me nothing else to do but to appreciate the new system.I would highly recommend Hobb’s Electrical to anyone requiring this kind of work.

I organised this system for a family friend who lives nearby.The pre-sale conversations with Hobbs Electrical team was helpful and informing. They provided sufficient details and were transparent with their communications. They organized the quotes multiple times as we changed the design. The pre-sale part of the installation was satisfactory and trustworthy.However, the installers on the day all of a sudden decided to change the installation configuration we designed for the roof to avoid shading from nearby trees. They thought the system would look better to the eye if they put the panels in a more symmetrical way. We had to convince them to follow the original design we agreed in the first place so the system would be less shaded. This part was not professional, if no one was around during the day to check on the installation, the system layout would have been installed incorrectly.Also, customer service after-sales has been disappointing.Overall rating 3.5/5.0

Great prompt, professional quote, friendly installation. Handled an unexpected problem with 3 phase on the spot. Only marred by retailer taking 90 days to arrive to hook it up, after which Hobbs arrived to complete in 90 minutes.
Hobbs offered a number of options and explained it throughly. Their service and flexibility was commendable. Installation team were great and efficient.

I can't speak more highly of the whole process. Prompt, well explained quote which was well priced in comparison to other quotes  we obtained. Rhys was happy to explain/modify the design several times to get exactly what we were after.Every member of staff we spoke to were friendly and great to work with. Tom and his team installed the system with no mess left behind and their communication was great. The install was quicker than we expected and the work was neat and completed to a high standard. I will be recommending Hobbs to anyone looking at a solar system for their home/property.

The team was helpful and explained how they were going to do the job and why the panels were situated where they were needed. I received regular contact, the payments were easily made.My power box was old and insufficient for the job so it was replaced at a good price. They gave notice when they would start the work and they arrived on time and completed the job on time

The quote process was great from start to finish.The installers did a great job and knowing that it was one company doing the whole installation gave us peace of mind. They were all polite and hard-working on one very hot day, and the installation went perfectly.Customer service was great and I was shown the system worked on the day. One day after the installation, it all seems to be running perfectly
Quoting stage was informative about solar and the actual installation.The team were professional, friendly and took care with the installation.   Left no trace.

The team at Hobbs were great. The boys were so professional and actually showed up on time, their quote was fair and the products they used were top notch.Their knowledge was also incredible, they answered all my questions, didn't make me feel like an absolute dummy and if they didn't know the answer, I got a call later on with it.I also loved how the guys were super supportive of a ground mounted system as the roof space on our Tiny house just wasn't going to cut it.Would recommend any day.

Best thing is communication. I haven't found myself wanting to know "what's going on?" as they always kept us informed.As we were going from a single phase service to a three phase service, there was a lot to do. We also requested service on our property to be placed underground.We, at the same time, were expanding our solar and getting batteries installed. We also had a three phase car charger installed. All this was done with no fuss. When I had questions, these were always answered with honesty. There were a couple of questions they didn't know the answer to at that time, but were courteous enough to find out for us. At no time did they try to "bullsh*t" their way through.All their staff were always very courteous, polite and thoughtful.If they were experiencing any delays, of which there were only a couple of, they always let me know before they were due to arrive.At all times they were tidy and if things had to be moved, always replace items as close practical.At all stages, our site was left clean and tidy.I would highly recommend their services.N.B. I would need a drone to photograph the solar panels as half of them are not visible from the ground, hence no solar panel photos.

Right from my initial phone call to make an appt this was an excellent experience.  The Sales Representative was very pleasant and totally in charge of his brief, answering all questions in terms that I could understand. He took photos of the roof and asked where I would like the panels. The quote arrived the next day, with loads of very interesting information about the various aspects of solar panels.The installation went extremely well with the installers arriving a little before time and were happy to begin straight away. They were polite, respectful and totally cleaned up and took packaging etc away with them.   I was even asked when it would be convenient for me to have the electricity turned off for a while.The head electrician was very patient, and again polite and explained the app, the information on it and showed me how to use the charger.  Hobbs also organised the grid connection so I did not have to do anything.A great company to deal with and I would recommend Hobbs Electrical installation without any hesitation.

We are very happy with our new Enphase system recommended by Rhys. The Hobbs installers Tom and Zak were on time and provided excellent service. They were very efficient, polite and completed it all in a day.

I’m pleased to share that the performance of our recently installed 9kW ENPHASE solar system has exceeded our expectations!We want to commend the tradespeople who commissioned and installed the system. Their expertise and clear communication about the operation were invaluable. The system is paired with 2 TESLA Powerwall 2 batteries, a decision that has proven to be very effective. The setup allows us to maintain a virtually cost-neutral supply of electricity during non-solar hours. Additionally, we’ve configured our hot water heating to optimize solar energy usage.According to our grid supplier's website, our daily cost is currently 0.74 cents, and our projected quarterly bill is just $58.61—an excellent outcome.It has been a pleasure working with Hobbs Electrical. They have kept us well-informed throughout the entire installation process. Solar power relies heavily on sound advice and reliable technical expertise, and we found both with Hobbs Electrical. Overall, we are extremely satisfied with the results and highly recommend their services.
